subject.title: feat: add LLMTR provider for Turkey-hosted and global models

question: Should LLMTR be accepted as a permanently bundled OpenClaw provider, or should it remain an independently maintained plugin?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible and uses an existing extension seam, but repository direction makes optional bundled-provider promotion a maintainer product and ownership choice rather than a mechanical review outcome.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Close this bundled branch and publish the provider as an independently maintained npm/ClawHub plugin using the demonstrated SDK integration.

options.title: Sponsor bundled support
options.body: A provider/plugin owner explicitly sponsors the bundled catalog, onboarding contract, release maintenance, and dependency-guard exception for a refreshed PR.

recommendation.title: Keep it external
recommendation.body: Close this bundled branch and publish the provider as an independently maintained npm/ClawHub plugin using the demonstrated SDK integration.

likelyOwner.reason: That group owns the decision to make an optional provider part of the supported bundled distribution.
